halls.name: Ansariya Gulf Auditorium
halls.location: Jattipalla Road, Navoor, Sullia, Dakshina Kannada
halls.address: Jattipalla Road, Navoor, Sullia, Dakshina Kannada
halls.description: A massive community destination perfect for grand traditional marriages and large family receptions.
halls.rules:
1. Hall premises must be vacated strictly by the conclusion of the booked time slot.
2. Moderate decibel sound limits must be observed after 10:00 PM per civic guidelines.
3. Advance payment is required to confirm reservation within the 48-hour hold window.
4. Cleanliness of the dining and catering bays must be maintained.

halls.name: K.V.G Samudaya Bhavana
halls.location: Aletty Road, Sullia, Dakshina Kannada (Near KVG Engineering College Campus)
halls.address: Aletty Road, Sullia, Dakshina Kannada (Near KVG Engineering College Campus)
halls.description: Massive multi-hall landmark featuring dedicated dual-catering layouts (separate veg/non-veg spaces), extensive heavy-duty kitchens, and expansive vehicle parking.
halls.rules:
1. Separate vegetarian and non-vegetarian catering sections must be strictly observed.
2. Campus security regulations apply for late night vehicle movement.
3. Advance payment of 25% locks the slot atomically upon supervisor confirmation.
4. Outside decorators must clear scaffolding within 3 hours of event closure.

halls.name: Okkaliga Gowda Samudaya Bhavana
halls.location: Tenkila, Mani-Puttur Bypass, Puttur, Dakshina Kannada
halls.address: Tenkila, Mani-Puttur Bypass, Puttur, Dakshina Kannada
halls.description: Newly renovated, premium 28,000 sq. ft. modern architectural masterpiece featuring a massive underground basement dining hall fitting over 1,500 people.
halls.rules:
1. Underground basement dining hall elevators and escalators are monitored by building security.
2. Advance payment is required upon supervisor approval to secure slot hold.
3. Waste disposal must be segregated at source in the utility collection bay.

halls.name: Havyaka Sabha Bhavana
halls.description: Clean, peaceful traditional venue positioned comfortably away from city traffic jams, located right adjacent to the Balamuri Ganapati Temple.
halls.rules:
1. Pure vegetarian catering is permitted on hall premises.
2. Temple sanctity guidelines and peaceful decibel norms must be respected.
3. 25% advance locks the reservation atomically.

halls.name: Janapriya Garden Hall
halls.description: Beautiful, sprawling green lawn venue featuring distinct standalone architecture, flexible separate dining spaces, and massive outdoor vehicle parking grounds.
halls.rules:
1. Highway approach and parking marshals must ensure clear vehicle corridors.
2. Lawn decorations and tent stakes must not damage underground turf irrigation.
3. Amplified music transitions indoors by 10:00 PM.

halls.name: Indian Auditorium
halls.location: Peraje, Neralkatte near Mani, Bantwal, Dakshina Kannada
halls.address: Peraje, Neralkatte near Mani, Bantwal, Dakshina Kannada
halls.description: Strategic central crossroads venue built with an accessible all-ground-floor design where the main seating hall, stage, and catering bays align seamlessly on a single tier.
halls.rules:
1. Ground-floor accessibility ramps and fire egress points must remain unobstructed.
2. Automatic generator fuel backup surcharge applies for continuous power over 8 hours.
3. Advance payment holds slot exclusively for 48 hours.

halls.name: Sagar Auditorium
halls.description: Premium, heavily soundproofed multi-tier venue offering robust central air conditioning, pristine indoor acoustic treatments, and an isolated dining hall layout lower down.
halls.rules:
1. Central air conditioning and acoustic sound limiter guidelines apply.
2. Separate lower-tier dining access requires designated catering crew passes.
3. Advance payment locks slot upon supervisor approval.

halls.name: Adyar Gardens
halls.location: Highway opposite Sahyadri College, Adyar, Mangalore, Dakshina Kannada
halls.address: Highway opposite Sahyadri College, Adyar, Mangalore, Dakshina Kannada
halls.description: One of the district's premier luxury destination landmarks blending magnificent indoor grand halls with beautiful, manicured open-air green lawns.
halls.rules:
1. Lawn ceremonies must conform to civic decibel guidelines past 10:00 PM.
2. Highway parking marshals provided for large gatherings.
3. Full reservation tariff includes generator backup and housekeeping.

halls.name: Shoolin Palace
halls.location: Airport Road, Maravoor Bridge, Mangalore, Dakshina Kannada
halls.address: Airport Road, Maravoor Bridge, Mangalore, Dakshina Kannada
halls.description: Ultra-premium, upscale resort-style palace featuring soundproof interiors, private luxury stay suites, and a dramatic movable stage system set over a sleek swimming pool.
halls.rules:
1. Pool safety protocols and movable stage operations monitored by certified staff.
2. Private luxury suites check-in coordinated with event timeline.
3. 25% advance holds booking upon supervisor confirmation.
